title: ldjam: draft + publish micro-blog integration
description:
Wire .claude/skills/ldjam/scripts/publish-post.sh to actually POST to
api.ldjam.com. The script is currently a --dry-run-only scaffold because
the /vx/node/add payload shape for ldjam posts is not publicly documented
and I didn't want to guess at it blind.

==> CLOSE-THE-LOOP ACTION FOR ANDREW <==
  1. Log in to https://ldjam.com in a browser as zigtalk.
  2. Open devtools → Network tab, filter to api.ldjam.com.
  3. Manually create ONE short test post under your user profile.
  4. Copy the full request for POST /vx/node/add (headers + form data
     or JSON body) into .claude/analysis/ldjam-post-request.txt
     (gitignored via .claude/analysis/).
  5. Come back to Claude — Claude will update publish-post.sh to match
     that shape, verify with --dry-run, then send a real post.
  6. Also capture the request for screenshot/file upload if you did one
     in the same test post, so we can wire that too.

Don't delete the test post — we'll treat it as the first devlog stub and
edit it via /vx/node/update/<id> once the skill is live.

title: meta: lock game direction from brainstorm
description: Phase Chorus (Kuramoto synchrony) was prototyped and REJECTED — player agency too weak (system syncs mostly on its own), visuals bland. Returning to ideate with better taste after studying external skill repos. New filter: player agency must be primary, not a small perturbation on an emergent system.
notes: Prototype lives at /ld59/prototypes/phase-chorus/ as a historical reference.

title: prototype: Phase Chorus (Kuramoto synchrony) deployable to GH Pages
description: Build a playable prototype of the Phase Chorus mechanic so Zig can feel whether it's fun before we commit to it as the LD59 direction. Location: ludum-dare/59-signal/prototypes/phase-chorus/. TS + Vite + Bun + Canvas 2D. Deploy via existing .github/workflows/deploy.yml; URL path /ld59/prototypes/phase-chorus/. See bead description for full physics + visual spec.
